name: health-band
description: A band above the prompt. Always: a gauge row with LSE requests today (LSE n/15000, yellow >10k, red >14k), helper-agent jobs today from the dispatch.sh logs, and the fixed per-turn context overhead of plugins and skills. Issue rows moved to the second-brain window (brain-sync); /healthband lists every issue when launchd logs show Anthropic API credit errors, ~/.lse_key is missing or rejected, a live feed's newest bar is older than its market-minute limit, or a forward job is stale. It also watches scheduled tasks and launchd jobs, the AutoRank backup and sign-ins, the LSE v2 shutdown (HTTP 410), and forward-job data that stopped arriving, and sends one notification when a new red issue appears. Checks every 5 min; /healthband lists everything.
